cases.purpose: binhex encode and decode give exact output when stdin is a pipe fed in 1000-byte chunks (many short reads, hex pairs split across reads); when a trapped SIGUSR1 interrupts read(2) on a FIFO three times and write(2) to a full FIFO six times (EINTR with nothing written, and short counts after one page is freed); and when a seccomp listener answers stdin read(2) with EINTR twice and stdout write(2) with EINTR then a synthetic short count of 100.
cases.oracle: Independent Python 3 driver (sio.py): inputs and expected hex from bytes.hex(); /proc/PID/wchan pipe_read/pipe_write shows the side shell blocked before each signal (Bash installs trap handlers without SA_RESTART); pinned helpers/system-sequence.py records and answers notified calls. A synthetic short return performs no I/O, so a correct continuation loop yields exactly the expected bytes after the first 100.
cases.comparison: Contract: exact stdout and empty stderr. Reads/writes are checked by output bytes, read-call counts from the helper log, signal/blocked counts from the driver, and trap execution in the shell.
cases.script:
S() { /usr/bin/python3 sio.py "$@"; }
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
inj() { local log=$1 cmd=$2; shift 2; : > "$log"; /usr/bin/python3 "$H" "$@" --log "$log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd"; }
S make
/usr/bin/mkfifo in.fifo out.fifo
me=$BASHPID traps=0
trap 'traps=$((traps + 1))' USR1
# natural short reads: 1000-byte chunks into a pipe (encode, and decode with hex pairs split)
inj "$HOME/r1.jsonl" 'binhex < in.fifo > drip.hex; printf "%d\n" "$?" >&2' --notify read:0=0 2> st.txt &
p=$!; S feed 0 in.fifo small.bin 0 > /dev/null; wait "$p"
printf 'drip-encode status=%s\n' "$(< st.txt)"; S check drip-encode drip.hex small.hex; S reads drip-encode "$HOME/r1.jsonl" 100
inj "$HOME/r2.jsonl" 'binhex -d < in.fifo > drip.bin; printf "%d\n" "$?" >&2' --notify read:0=0 2> st.txt &
p=$!; S feed 0 in.fifo small.hex 0 > /dev/null; wait "$p"
printf 'drip-decode status=%s\n' "$(< st.txt)"; S check drip-decode drip.bin small.bin; S reads drip-decode "$HOME/r2.jsonl" 200
# trapped signals while blocked in read(2) on a FIFO: EINTR is retried
S feed "$me" in.fifo small.bin 3 & f=$!
binhex < in.fifo > eintr.hex; s=$?; wait "$f"
printf 'signal-read status=%d traps-ran=%s\n' "$s" "$([[ $traps -ge 1 ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; S check signal-read eintr.hex small.hex
# trapped signals while blocked in write(2) to a full FIFO: EINTR and short counts
traps=0
S drain "$me" out.fifo drained.hex 3 > drain.txt & f=$!
binhex plain.bin > out.fifo; s=$?; wait "$f"; cat drain.txt
printf 'signal-write status=%d traps-ran=%s\n' "$s" "$([[ $traps -ge 1 ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; S check signal-write drained.hex plain.hex
# injected EINTR on read, and EINTR then a short count of 100 on write
for mode in encode decode; do
  if [[ $mode == encode ]]; then opt= src=small.bin want=small.hex; else opt=-d src=small.hex want=small.bin; fi
  inj "$HOME/a.jsonl" "binhex $opt < $src > inj.out; printf '%d\n' \"\$?\" >&2" --notify read:0=0 --reply-seq read=EINTR,EINTR 2> st.txt
  printf 'inject-read-%s status=%s\n' "$mode" "$(< st.txt)"; S check "inject-read-$mode" inj.out "$want"; S log "inject-read-$mode" "$HOME/a.jsonl" read
  inj "$HOME/b.jsonl" "binhex $opt < $src > inj.out; printf '%d\n' \"\$?\" >&2" --notify write:0=1 --reply-seq write=EINTR,100 2> st.txt
  printf 'inject-write-%s status=%s\n' "$mode" "$(< st.txt)"; S check "inject-write-$mode" inj.out "$want" 100; S log "inject-write-$mode" "$HOME/b.jsonl" write
done
trap - USR1
/usr/bin/rm -f in.fifo out.fifo st.txt drain.txt *.hex *.bin *.out plain.* "$HOME"/*.jsonl

cases.purpose: For every codec (gzip, zlib, deflate, xz, lzma, zstd, bzip2): stdin read(2) answered EINTR twice is retried in decode and encode; stdout write(2) answered EINTR then a synthetic short count of 1000 is continued from that offset; a write(2) returning 0 is reported as an error after one call rather than retried; an RLIMIT_FSIZE short write (1024 bytes) followed by EFBIG is reported with the prefix kept, and the next invocation works. Real trapped SIGUSR1 interruptions of read(2) on a FIFO (gzip decode/encode) and of write(2) to a full FIFO (gzip and xz decode, EINTR and short counts) give exact output.
cases.oracle: Independent Python 3 driver (sio.py) with stdlib gzip/zlib/lzma/bz2 encoders for the inputs and expected bytes; zstd input is the candidate's own encoding checked by round trip. /proc/PID/wchan shows the shell blocked before each signal; pinned helpers/system-sequence.py records and answers notified calls; the kernel enforces RLIMIT_FSIZE (1 KiB soft, SIGXFSZ ignored). Expected zero-write behaviour is the topic obligation ("treated as an error, not looped forever").
cases.comparison: Contract: exact stdout and empty stderr. Output bytes, helper call counts, statuses and diagnostic presence (wording excluded except "File too large" for EFBIG).
cases.script:
S() { /usr/bin/python3 sio.py "$@"; }
H=/opt/bashos-parity/harness/helpers/system-sequence.py
inj() { local log=$1 cmd=$2; shift 2; : > "$log"; /usr/bin/python3 "$H" "$@" --log "$log" -- "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "$cmd"; }
S make
/usr/bin/mkfifo in.fifo out.fifo
me=$BASHPID traps=0
trap 'traps=$((traps + 1))' USR1
FORMATS='gzip zlib deflate xz lzma zstd bzip2'
src() { case $1 in gzip) echo plain.gz;; zlib) echo plain.zlib;; deflate) echo plain.deflate;; xz) echo plain.xz;;
  lzma) echo plain.lzma;; zstd) echo plain.zst;; bzip2) echo plain.bz2;; esac; }
zlib -e -f zstd < plain.bin > plain.zst; printf 'make-zstd status=%d\n' "$?"
# trapped signals while blocked in read(2): gzip decode and encode from a FIFO
S feed "$me" in.fifo plain.gz 3 & f=$!
zlib -d < in.fifo > sig.bin; s=$?; wait "$f"
printf 'signal-read-decode status=%d traps-ran=%s\n' "$s" "$([[ $traps -ge 1 ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; S check signal-read-decode sig.bin plain.bin
traps=0
S feed "$me" in.fifo small.bin 3 & f=$!
zlib -e < in.fifo > sig.gz; s=$?; wait "$f"
printf 'signal-read-encode status=%d traps-ran=%s\n' "$s" "$([[ $traps -ge 1 ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; S gunzip signal-read-encode sig.gz small.bin
# trapped signals while blocked in write(2) to a full FIFO: gzip and xz decode
for fmt in gzip xz; do
  traps=0
  S drain "$me" out.fifo drained.bin 3 > drain.txt & f=$!
  zlib -d -f "$fmt" < "$(src "$fmt")" > out.fifo; s=$?; wait "$f"; cat drain.txt
  printf 'signal-write-%s status=%d traps-ran=%s\n' "$fmt" "$s" "$([[ $traps -ge 1 ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; S check "signal-write-$fmt" drained.bin plain.bin
done
zeros=$(printf '0,%.0s' {1..200}); zeros=${zeros%,}
for fmt in $FORMATS; do
  in=$(src "$fmt")
  inj "$HOME/a.jsonl" "zlib -d -f $fmt < $in > o.bin; printf '%d\n' \"\$?\" >&2" --notify read:0=0 --reply-seq read=EINTR,EINTR 2> st.txt
  printf 'inject-read-decode-%s status=%s\n' "$fmt" "$(< st.txt)"; S check "inject-read-decode-$fmt" o.bin plain.bin; S log "inject-read-decode-$fmt" "$HOME/a.jsonl" read
  inj "$HOME/a.jsonl" "zlib -e -f $fmt < small.bin > o.enc; printf '%d\n' \"\$?\" >&2" --notify read:0=0 --reply-seq read=EINTR,EINTR 2> st.txt
  zlib -d -f "$fmt" < o.enc > o.bin
  printf 'inject-read-encode-%s status=%s roundtrip=%d\n' "$fmt" "$(< st.txt)" "$?"; S check "inject-read-encode-$fmt" o.bin small.bin
  inj "$HOME/b.jsonl" "zlib -d -f $fmt < $in > o.bin; printf '%d\n' \"\$?\" >&2" --notify write:0=1 --reply-seq write=EINTR,1000 2> st.txt
  printf 'inject-write-%s status=%s\n' "$fmt" "$(< st.txt)"; S check "inject-write-$fmt" o.bin plain.bin 1000; S log "inject-write-$fmt" "$HOME/b.jsonl" write
  # the status is recorded by creating st-N (no write(2), so no listener reply is consumed)
  /usr/bin/rm -f st-*
  inj "$HOME/c.jsonl" "zlib -d -f $fmt < $in > o.bin 2> e.txt; : > st-\$?" --notify write:0=1 --reply-seq "write=$zeros"
  zst=(st-*)
  printf 'zero-write-%s status=%s diagnostic=%s\n' "$fmt" "${zst[0]#st-}" "$([[ -s e.txt ]] && echo yes || echo no)"; S count "zero-write-$fmt" "$HOME/c.jsonl" write
  trap '' XFSZ; hard=$(ulimit -H -f)
  ulimit -S -f 1; zlib -d -f "$fmt" < "$in" > lim.bin 2> e.txt; s=$?; ulimit -S -f "$hard"; trap - XFSZ
  printf 'fsize-%s status=%d diagnostic=%s\n' "$fmt" "$s" "$(/usr/bin/grep -c 'File too large' e.txt)"; S prefix "fsize-$fmt" lim.bin plain.bin 1024
  zlib -d -f "$fmt" < "$in" > after.bin; printf 'after-%s status=%d\n' "$fmt" "$?"; S check "after-$fmt" after.bin plain.bin
done
trap - USR1
/usr/bin/rm -f in.fifo out.fifo st.txt st-* e.txt drain.txt *.bin *.hex *.gz *.enc plain.* "$HOME"/*.jsonl

cases.purpose: With an eight-block seekable stdin (blocks A..H), the third read(2) on stdin fails with EIO (the kernel never runs it, so the offset does not advance): conv=noerror,sync and conv=noerror diagnose the error, continue, skip the bad block and copy the later good blocks at the correct offsets (C replaced by NULs with sync, omitted without), with GNU dd's record counts and nonzero status.
cases.oracle: GNU coreutils dd with the same input and the same pinned helpers/system-sequence.py reply sequence (continue, continue, EIO across the side's stdin read(2) calls)
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr (status=noxfer removes timing); output blocks are summarised by blocks.py; helper log gives the stdin read count and the injected position.

files.blocks.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted block summariser for dd fixtures (takeover root): one letter per
# 512-byte block (NUL for an all-zero block), and helper-log read counts.
import json, sys
if sys.argv[1] == 'make':
    open('in.bin', 'wb').write(b''.join(bytes([65 + i]) * 512 for i in range(8)))
elif sys.argv[1] == 'blocks':
    data = open(sys.argv[2], 'rb').read()
    marks = []
    for k in range(0, len(data), 512):
        b = data[k:k + 512]
        marks.append('NUL' if b == bytes(len(b)) else (chr(b[0]) if b == b[:1] * len(b) else 'mixed'))
    print('%s bytes=%d blocks=%s' % (sys.argv[3], len(data), ','.join(marks)))
else:
    rows = [json.loads(l) for l in open(sys.argv[2]) if json.loads(l).get('syscall') == 'read']
    print('%s stdin-reads=%d eio-at=%s' % (sys.argv[3], len(rows), [i + 1 for i, r in enumerate(rows) if r['reply'] != 'continue']))

    "$BASH" --noprofile --norc -c "dd bs=512 conv=$conv status=noxfer of=out.bin < in.bin; printf '[$conv] status=%d\n' \"\$?\""

done

cases.purpose: Owned tmpfs files written by the trusted helper are fully resident: 64 pages + 123 bytes reports PAGES = ceil(size/PAGESIZE) = 65 and RES = 65 pages, and PAGESIZE-1, PAGESIZE and PAGESIZE+1 byte files report 1, 1 and 2 pages, in default, -b and --noheadings -b forms, matching util-linux fincore (which can use cachestat(2) on files the caller owns).
cases.oracle: util-linux fincore on the same owned files
cases.comparison: Byte parity of status, stdout and stderr with markers on both streams; no normalisation.

files.fcobs.py:
# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted page-cache controller and mincore(2) oracle for fincore fixtures
# (takeover root). tmpfs files (owned) serve util-linux parity; a read-only
# ext4 root-image file serves eviction states, where util-linux cachestat(2)
# is refused for a non-owner. It never runs the candidate.
import ctypes, os, sys

PAGE = os.sysconf('SC_PAGESIZE')
libc = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
libc.mmap.restype = ctypes.c_void_p
libc.mmap.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_long]
libc.munmap.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t]
libc.mincore.argtypes = [ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_size_t, ctypes.c_void_p]


def resident(path):
    size = os.stat(path).st_size
    fd = os.open(path, os.O_RDONLY)
    addr = libc.mmap(None, size, 1, 1, fd, 0)
    os.close(fd)
    n = (size + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
    vec = (ctypes.c_ubyte * n)()
    if libc.mincore(addr, size, vec) != 0:
        raise SystemExit('mincore: ' + os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno()))
    libc.munmap(addr, size)
    return sum(v & 1 for v in vec), size


def pick():
    for top, dirs, files in os.walk('/usr/share'):
        dirs.sort()
        for name in sorted(files):
            path = os.path.join(top, name)
            if os.path.islink(path) or not os.path.isfile(path) or not os.access(path, os.R_OK):
                continue
            if 64 * PAGE < os.stat(path).st_size < 256 * PAGE:
                return path
    return 'none'


def main():
    cmd, a = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2:]
    if cmd == 'make':
        for name, size in (('below', PAGE - 1), ('page', PAGE), ('above', PAGE + 1), ('big', 64 * PAGE + 123)):
            with open(name, 'wb') as handle:
                handle.write(bytes((i * 7) % 251 for i in range(size)))
        return
    if cmd == 'pick':
        print(pick())
        return
    if cmd == 'check':
        # check LABEL PATH OUT STATUS WANT: parse 'fincore -b -n' and compare with mincore
        label, path, out, status, want = a
        row = open(out).read().split()
        pages, size = resident(path)
        full = (size + PAGE - 1) // PAGE
        expect = {'cold': 0, 'one': 1, 'full': full}[want]
        good = (len(row) == 4 and row[3] == path and row[0] == str(pages * PAGE) and row[1] == str(pages)
                and row[2] == str(size))
        print('%s status=%s state=%s oracle=%s' % (label, status, want if pages == expect else 'pages-%d' % pages,
                                                   'match' if good else 'differ:%s' % row))
        return
    fd = os.open(a[0], os.O_RDONLY)
    if cmd == 'cold':
        os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)
    elif cmd == 'one':
        os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_DONTNEED)
        os.posix_fadvise(fd, 0, 0, os.POSIX_FADV_RANDOM)
        os.pread(fd, PAGE, 0)
    elif cmd == 'warm':
        while os.read(fd, 1 << 16):
            pass
    os.close(fd)


main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted mount-namespace builder for table-driven fixtures (pane 214). Runs
# as uid 0 of a fresh user+mount namespace (unshare --user --map-root-user
# --mount), applies SPEC in order with mount(2), then executes PROGRAM. The
# "check" form applies nothing: it verifies, inside an identically built
# namespace, that every step took effect (setup control).
# SPEC is a JSON list of steps:
#   ["tmpfs", PATH, READONLY]   private tmpfs (size=1m) at PATH, optionally MS_RDONLY
#   ["bind", SOURCE, TARGET]    bind SOURCE over TARGET (file or directory)
#   ["symlink", TARGET, LINK]   create LINK -> TARGET (inside a mounted tmpfs)
#   ["mkdir", PATH]             create a directory (inside a mounted tmpfs)
#   ["shadow", DIR, NAME]       bind DIR to ./shadow-stash, mount a tmpfs over DIR and
#                               relink every entry except NAME (symlinks copied as-is,
#                               others point into the stash), so DIR/NAME is absent
# Usage: ns_build.py SPEC PROGRAM [ARG...] | ns_build.py check SPEC
import ctypes, json, os, sys

MS_RDONLY, MS_REMOUNT, MS_BIND = 1, 32, 4096
lib = ctypes.CDLL(None, use_errno=True)
STASH = os.path.abspath('shadow-stash')


def mount(source, target, fstype, flags, data):
    if lib.mount(source.encode(), target.encode(), fstype.encode() if fstype else None, ctypes.c_ulong(flags),
                 data.encode() if data else None) != 0:
        print('SETUP-INVALID mount %s on %r: %s' % (fstype or 'bind', target, os.strerror(ctypes.get_errno())))
        sys.exit(97)


def apply(spec):
    for step in spec:
        kind = step[0]
        if kind == 'tmpfs':
            mount('parity-ns', step[1], 'tmpfs', MS_RDONLY if step[2] else 0, 'size=1m,mode=0755')
        elif kind == 'bind':
            mount(step[1], step[2], None, MS_BIND, None)
        elif kind == 'symlink':
            os.symlink(step[1], step[2])
        elif kind == 'mkdir':
            os.mkdir(step[1])
        elif kind == 'shadow':
            os.makedirs(STASH, exist_ok=True)
            mount(step[1], STASH, None, MS_BIND, None)
            names = os.listdir(STASH)
            mount('parity-ns', step[1], 'tmpfs', 0, 'size=1m,mode=0755')
            for name in names:
                if name == step[2]:
                    continue
                held = os.path.join(STASH, name)
                os.symlink(os.readlink(held) if os.path.islink(held) else held, os.path.join(step[1], name))
        else:
            raise AssertionError(kind)


def check(spec):
    for step in spec:
        kind = step[0]
        if kind == 'tmpfs':
            parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(step[1]))
            ok = os.stat(step[1]).st_dev != os.stat(parent).st_dev
            ok = ok and bool(os.statvfs(step[1]).f_flag & os.ST_RDONLY) == bool(step[2])
        elif kind == 'bind':
            with open(step[1], 'rb') as a, open(step[2], 'rb') as b:
                ok = a.read() == b.read()
        elif kind == 'symlink':
            ok = os.readlink(step[2]) == step[1]
        elif kind == 'shadow':
            ok = (not os.path.lexists(os.path.join(step[1], step[2]))
                  and set(os.listdir(step[1])) == set(os.listdir(STASH)) - {step[2]})
        else:
            ok = os.path.isdir(step[1])
        if not ok:
            print('CONTROL-FAILED namespace step %r did not take effect' % (step,))
            sys.exit(98)
    print('namespace control ok')


def main():
    if os.geteuid() != 0:
        print('SETUP-INVALID ns_build.py must run as user-namespace root')
        sys.exit(97)
    if sys.argv[1] == 'check':
        with open(sys.argv[2]) as handle:
            check(json.load(handle))
        return
    with open(sys.argv[1]) as handle:
        apply(json.load(handle))
    os.execv(sys.argv[2], sys.argv[2:])


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()

# SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT
# Trusted vmstat sampling observer (takeover root): runs the side shell's
# vmstat with a delay, timestamps each output line, reads /proc/stat and
# /proc/meminfo before and after, and checks structure, cadence and rates.
import subprocess, sys, time

H1 = 'procs -----------memory---------- ---swap-- -----io---- -system-- -------cpu-------'
H2 = ' r  b   swpd   free   buff  cache   si   so    bi    bo   in   cs us sy id wa st gu'


def stat():
    vals = {}
    for line in open('/proc/stat'):
        f = line.split()
        if f[0] in ('intr', 'ctxt'):
            vals[f[0]] = int(f[1])
    return vals


def memtotal():
    for line in open('/proc/meminfo'):
        if line.startswith('MemTotal:'):
            return int(line.split()[1])


def main():
    shell, args, label = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[2], sys.argv[3]
    before = stat()
    proc = subprocess.Popen([shell, '--noprofile', '--norc', '-c', 'vmstat ' + args], stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    lines = []
    for raw in proc.stdout:
        lines.append((time.monotonic(), raw.decode().rstrip('\n')))
    err = proc.stderr.read()
    status = proc.wait()
    after = stat()
    total = memtotal()
    heads = [i for i, (_, l) in enumerate(lines) if l == H1]
    rows = [(t, l.split()) for t, l in lines if l not in (H1, H2)]
    shape = all(len(f) == 18 and all(x.isdigit() for x in f) for _, f in rows)
    gaps = [b[0] - a[0] for a, b in zip(rows, rows[1:])]
    cadence = all(0.85 <= g <= 1.6 for g in gaps)
    later = [list(map(int, f)) for _, f in rows[1:]] if shape else []
    cpu = all(abs(sum(v[12:18]) - 100) <= 3 for v in ([list(map(int, f)) for _, f in rows] if shape else []))
    rates = (all(v[10] > 0 and v[11] > 0 for v in later) and sum(v[11] for v in later) <= after['ctxt'] - before['ctxt']
             and sum(v[10] for v in later) <= after['intr'] - before['intr'])
    mem = all(int(f[3]) + int(f[4]) + int(f[5]) <= total and int(f[0]) >= 1 for _, f in rows) if shape else False
    print('%s status=%d stderr=%s header-at=%s rows=%d columns=%s cadence=%s cpu-sum=%s rates-bracketed=%s memory=%s' % (
        label, status, 'empty' if not err else 'diagnostic', heads, len(rows), 'ok' if shape else 'bad',
        'ok' if cadence else 'off:%s' % ['%.2f' % g for g in gaps], 'ok' if cpu else 'bad', 'ok' if rates else 'bad',
        'ok' if mem else 'bad'))


main()
